failures.error: ninja: error: build.ninja:540: unknown pool name 'link'
failures.cause: Pinned WasmEdge cmake/Helper.cmake sets CMAKE_JOB_POOLS and CMAKE_JOB_POOL_LINK in its dependency directory for Release + Ninja. Ninja pool declarations are generated from the root scope, where this pool was absent. LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS was unused and did not cause the failure.
failures.fix: Pass CMAKE_JOB_POOLS=link=1 at the iOS runtime root configure. Build runtime before lazy one-time host TableGen and target LLVM builds.
